scenes.text: Imagine opening your Bible and reading that you are actually commanded to commit adultery.
In 1631, the royal printers accidentally left out the word 'not' in the Seventh Commandment, printing 'Thou shalt commit adultery'.
An angry King Charles the First instantly recalled the Bibles, burned every copy he could find, and slapped the printers with a massive fine.
Today, only fifteen of these ultra-rare 'Wicked Bibles' still exist, so would you ever keep one in your house?
